details:
Category:

Feature Requests / Accessibility / UI

Description:

It would be awesome if VRChat added a native subtitle bar at the bottom of the screen to help players who speak different languages understand each other. This would be a game changer, especially for Quest standalone players who can't run background translation apps.

How it works with AI:

Background AI models process the spoken audio in real time, auto-detecting the language and generating fast text translations on screen.

How it could look:

A simple black translucent bar at the bottom of the screen (like movie subtitles), so it doesn't cover avatars or block your view.

What it should show:

[Username] ("Original text" ➔ "Translated text") [Language • Distance/Direction]

Example:

[Alex_VR] ("Look at this!" ➔ "¡Mira esto!") [English • 2.5m Right]

Free and VRC+ Options:

Free: AI-powered text subtitles on screen for everyone. Using fast, lightweight AI models locally or on servers keeps FPS high and saves Quest battery.

VRC+: Advanced AI voice-to-voice features (like translated voice cloning) could be an extra perk for subscribers.

Why this helps:

Showing the username, distance, and direction makes it super easy to spot who's talking in a crowded world. It keeps things lightweight while making it way easier to hang out with international friends
title: Title: Subtitle bar for auto-translation with speaker info anddistance
